1. (Currently amended) A cosmetic composition comprising an indole compound of formula I:

[Formula I structure]

wherein R1, R2, R3, R4, R5, R6, R7, R8, R9, R10, R11 and R12 are independently selected from hydrogen, halogen, alkyl, alkoxy, aryl, aryloxy, heteroaryl, heteroaryloxy, cycloalkyl, cycloalkoxy, heterocycloalkyl, heterocycloalkoxy, alkenyl, alkynyl, nitro, cyano, amino, alkylamino, dialkylamino, acyl, acyloxy, acylamino, sulfonyl, sulfonylamino, carboxyl, carboxylalkyl, carboxamido, hydroxyl, mercapto, alkylthio, or a physiologically acceptable salt thereof, __for use in improving skin appearance by reducing visible signs of aging__.

2. (Cancelled)

3. (Currently amended) Composition for topical use comprising a) the active ingredient according to Claim 1, b) one or more skin-tolerated vehicles, and c) optionally one or more further active compounds having a skin-care [[and/or inflammation-inhibiting]] action.

4. (Currently amended) Composition according to [[one or more of the]] Claim 1 or 3, wherein the active ingredient is contained in said composition in an amount of 0,00001 per cent by weight to 10 per cent by weight.

5. (Previously presented) Composition according to claim 1, comprising as a further skin-care ingredient ectoine.

6. (Currently amended) Composition according to claim 5, comprising as a further skin-care ingredient ectoine[[, preferably]] in an amount of 0.01 to 10 per cent by weight[[, more preferably 0.1 to 5 per cent by weight and especially 0.1 to 2 per cent by weight]].

7. (Currently amended) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 for the manufacture of a cosmetic composition __for improving skin appearance__.

8. (Currently amended) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 for the preparation of a composition which is suitable for the [[prophylaxis and/or]] treatment of skin diseases which are associated with defective keratinisation relating to differentiation and cell proliferation[[, in particular for the treatment of acne vulgaris, acne comedonica, polymorphic acne, acne rosaceae, nodular acne, acne conglobata, age-related acne, acne occurring as a side effect, such as acne solaris, medicament-related acne or acne professionalis, for the treatment of other defects of keratinisation, in particular ichthyosis, ichthyosiform states, Darier's disease, keratosis palmo- plantaris, leukoplakia, leukoplakiform states, skin and mucosal (buccal) eczema (lichen), for the treatment of other skin diseases which are associated with defective keratinisation and have an inflammatory and/or immunoallergic component, and in particular all forms of psoriasis relating to the skin, mucous membranes and finger- and toenails, and psoriatic rheumatism and skin atopy, such as eczema, or respiratory atopy, or also hypertrophy of the gums]].

9. (Currently amended) Use according to Claim 8 for hair care [[and/or hair follicle development]].

10. (Currently amended) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 for the care[[, preservation]] or improvement of the general state of the skin or hair.

11. (Previously presented) Use of active ingredient of Claim 1 or 2 as skin lightening and/or skin whitening active agent.

12. (Currently amended) Use of the composition according to Claim 1 for skin lightening and/or skin whitening.

13. (Currently amended) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 for the [[prophylaxis against or]] reduction of skin unevenness, such as wrinkles, fine lines, rough skin or large-pored skin.

14. (Currently amended) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 for the [[prophylaxis against time- and/or light-induced ageing processes of the human skin or human hair, in particular for prophylaxis against dry skin, wrinkle formation and/or pigment defects, and/or for the]] reduction [[or prevention]] of the [[harmful]] effects of UV rays on the skin.
